title: 產品碳足跡與生命週期評估
title_en: Product Carbon Footprint and Life Cycle Assessment
description: 產品碳足跡盤查(ISO 14067)、碳標籤、環境部 PCR 申請、生命週期評估（LCA）與計算服務。
description_en: Product carbon footprint inventories (ISO 14067), carbon labels, Environmental Protection Administration PCR applications, life cycle assessment (LCA), and calculation services.

title: 組織型溫室氣體盤查與範疇三
title_en: Organizational Greenhouse Gas Inventory and Scope 3
description: 企業組織型溫室氣體盤查（GHG protocol，ISO 14064-1相關標準）與建置輔導。
description_en: Consulting on organizational greenhouse gas inventories based on the GHG Protocol and ISO 14064-1-related standards.

title: 供應鏈減碳 (範疇3)與 SBTi 目標輔導
title_en: Supply Chain Decarbonization (Scope 3) and SBTi Target Consulting
description: 科學基礎減量目標（SBTi）、供應鏈低碳化升級轉型、供應鏈減碳。
description_en: Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), low-carbon supply chain transformation, and supply chain decarbonization.

title: 循環經濟與生物質資源利用
title_en: Circular Economy and Biomass Resource Utilization
description: 循環經濟商業模式評估、減碳效益評析、循環包裝減碳研究
description_en: Circular economy business model evaluation, carbon reduction benefit assessment, and research on low-carbon circular packaging.

title: ESG 策略規劃、永續報告與政策調查
title_en: ESG Strategy, Sustainability Reporting, and Policy Research
description: ESG 永續發展策略、永續報告書精進、供應鏈永續風險評估
description_en: ESG and sustainable development strategies, sustainability report improvement, and supply chain sustainability risk assessment.

title: 教育訓練、實戰工作坊與培訓
title_en: Education, Hands-on Workshops, and Professional Training
description: 永續與溫室氣體盤查知識培訓
description_en: Training in sustainability and greenhouse gas inventory practices.
